gen-dafont-nordic-gf-alexandria: Nordic's single-nib strokes and tightly closed letters, spaced out like scattered brush dabs, feel ancient and heavy. Alexandria, a plain sans with tall, open shapes, gives them room to breathe.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-amiko: Powerful and ancient, Nordic closes its letters tight and spaces them far apart like brush dabs. And Amiko, a modern sans-serif with outward-pointing terminals, opens everything up in return.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-bangla: Blunt, ancient, carved. Nordic cuts every stroke to a single depth, its letters shut tight against Anek Bangla's wide, open curves. Anek Bangla is a friendly sans that rewards a generous size for the text.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-devanagari: Stark and ancient, Nordic draws every line at an uninterrupted width, with closed letters scattered like brush dabs. Anek Devanagari's sans text gives it tall, open room.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-gujarati: Powerful from the first glance, Nordic keeps its lines flat and unmodulated, each letter pinched shut. Yet Anek Gujarati, a clean sans-serif with lowercase rivaling its capitals, gapes open and keeps things approachable.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi is a clean sans-serif with generous counters and open-handed curves, built to look relaxed beside what sits above it. Nordic's tight, brush-dab letters supply the ancient weight.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada reads as a modern sans-serif, its x-height high and terminals stopping well short of the stem. But Nordic holds stems and arcs in lockstep, which gives headings a powerful, ancient grip.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-latin: Nordic is powerful and ancient, with closed letters spaced like brush dabs. Anek Latin, a neutral sans-serif with tall lowercase nearly reaching the capitals, holds its shapes open, and that opposition is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-malayalam: Nordic spaces its tightly closed letters like brush dabs, with hairlines nowhere in sight. And Anek Malayalam, a plain sans whose curve tips never touch, loosens the whole page.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-anek-odia: Ancient and blunt: Nordic's monoline strokes sit tightly closed like a pressed leaf fold. Anek Odia, a clean sans with unlatched rounds, would stay easy going over a long passage.
